racemic indacrine (IND) is a potent diuretic with uricosuric properties.

IND is a diuretic that has been shown to be effective in man.
IND has the following actions: (1) a potent natriuretic effect, (2) a hypouricaemic effect, (3) an uricosuric effect, (4) a hypokalaemic effect and (5) a diuretic effect.
